Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno from CHEMBL221959 to include the parent and all salts. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then join activities on record_id, and join docs on doc_id. Join assays on assay_id and target_dictionary on tid. Filter for target CHEMBL2971 and IC50 activities with nM units. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Return all matching rows without limit.
